verdict.rationale: Asking whether a developer tool publishes a machine-readable API spec is a fair question, so the axis applies. No evidence shows Bruno offers a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404. The llms.txt docs index and Postman import/export are adjacent features, not an API spec for the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
